description: Build ERC20/SPL approve or revoke tx (does not broadcast). Sign with dex_wallet_sign_transaction after user confirmation.

action.description: Action type: 'approve' (default) or 'revoke' (revoke all approvals, Solana only)

amount.description: Approval amount (human-readable). Set to '0' to revoke approval (EVM), set to 'unlimited' or 'max' for maximum allowance

chain.description: Chain name (default ETH). Based on backend chain configuration.

max_fee_per_gas.description: EVM: override max fee per gas (wei)

max_priority_fee_per_gas.description: EVM: override max priority fee per gas (wei)

mcp_token.description: MCP session token obtained from login (dex_auth_google_login_poll or dex_auth_gate_login_poll). MUST be provided in every call to this tool after login; omitting it will result in 403

nonce.description: EVM: transaction nonce. Omit to auto-fetch current nonce.

priority_fee_micro_lamports.description: Solana: priority fee (micro-lamports per compute unit)

spender.description: Spender address (EVM: spender contract address; Solana: delegate account address)

token_contract.description: EVM: ERC20 contract address (required for EVM)

token_mint.description: Solana: SPL Token mint address (required for Solana)

name: dex_tx_approve_preview
